citations.excerpt: the council convened at Jerusalem in the year 50, to decide as to the authority of the law of Moses, and adjust the difference between Jewish and Gentile Christianity.

facts.value: Meeting of apostles, elders and church members at Jerusalem that decided whether Gentile converts were bound by the law of Moses.
